services.doc: A script for any question: the rendering walkthrough, or the offline answer with its lookups as steps.

services.name: CONTROL_LINE
services.doc: A control line, wherever the model put it and however it dressed it: `FLOW: …`, `**FLOW:** …`, `- FLOW: …`, `` `FLOW: …` ``

services.name: EMPTY_FENCE
services.doc: A code fence left empty once its control line is gone

services.name: splitControl
services.doc: Split the control lines (FLOW:, SUMMARY:, FOLLOWUPS:) off an answer, in any order and wherever they are, so none shows as text; the last of each kind wins.

services.name: parseFlow
services.doc: Parse a step line.

services.name: toMermaid
services.sig: export function toMermaid({ flow = null, hops = [], title = '' }, nameOf)
services.doc: Mermaid flowchart for an answer: from its step line, or else from its trail (hops between services).

services.name: flowGroups
services.doc: The step line's own path: a route as one group; stages joined last-to-first, stage to stage.

services.name: mapFocusOf
services.doc: What to light on the map for an answer: its diagram's items and arrows when it drew one (the picture the answer chose), otherwise every item it cites, joined within each paragraph.

services.name: splitFollowups
services.doc: Split off the follow-up line (kept for callers that only need follow-ups).

services.name: renderAnswer
services.sig: export function renderAnswer(text, isValid, nameOf, streaming = false)

services.name: basisPath
services.doc: A smooth curve through points, like d3's curveBasis (Mermaid's default).

services.name: breakCycles
services.doc: 1. Depth-first from the first node (the answer's starting point); an edge into a node still on the stack is a back edge.

services.name: layer
services.doc: 2. Layers by longest path (real nodes on even rows); a waypoint in every row an edge crosses.

services.name: order
services.doc: 3. Barycentre ordering, alternating down and up sweeps.

services.name: place
services.sig: function place(V, rows, up, down, gap)
services.doc: 4. Balanced x: place pushing left-first and right-first, each pulled towards neighbours; average the two.

services.name: layoutGraph
services.sig: export function layoutGraph(graph, { width, textWidth, nodeH = 26, rankGap = 34, gap = 16 })

services.name: route
services.sig: function route(edges, fwd, nodes, at, chain, V, X, yOf, nodeH, width)
services.doc: 5. Vertical exits and entries (so arrowheads point straight down), basis splines through the waypoints.

services.name: layoutLoop
services.sig: export function layoutLoop(loop, { width, textWidth, nodeH = 26, rowGap = 22, colGap = 56 })
services.doc: A dependency cycle as a racetrack: down the left column, a turn at the bottom, up the right column, a turn at the top. Every step is part of the same circuit (no special "return" edge) and every arrowhead is axis-aligned. Two-step loops are two boxes side by side, joined by an arc over the top and one under the bottom.

services.name: find
services.doc: Turn a phrase into a reference: exact name, @mention, "this"/"it" (the selection), or the best search match.

services.name: parseQuestion
services.doc: Which question is this, and about what?

services.name: answerLocally

services.doc: Answer a question from the index.

services.name: writtenMap
services.doc: The key `atlas map` wrote into the page: { key } on a written map, null on a built page.

services.name: llmTransport
services.doc: How this page reaches OpenRouter: the key written into it, the local proxy when `atlas serve` is serving it, or (on a built page only) a key the viewer gave; null when there is none.

services.name: useKey
services.doc: Use a key the viewer gave for the rest of this tab's life.

services.name: forgetKey
services.doc: Forget the viewer's key (after OpenRouter refuses it).

services.name: runTool
services.sig: function runTool(byName, call, onStep, steps, nameOf)

services.name: askOpenRouter

services.name: resolve
services.doc: Parse a reference or a name into { t: 'n'|'d'|'r', id }, or null. Names match exactly (case-insensitive), services first.

services.name: refName
services.doc: Display name of a reference.

services.name: CYCLE_SAMPLE
services.doc: module stays pure and imports nothing outside model, graph and util)

services.name: search
services.doc: Find services, endpoints, domains and repositories by name or by what they do.

services.name: impact
services.doc: What could break if a service changes. Endpoints are measured through their service.

services.name: cycles
services.doc: Dependency cycles: overall (services and modules/domains), or whether one item is part of one. Each loop is listed in order and comes back to its start.

leaves.name: repoOf
leaves.doc: which repositories a group spans, and a sample of its members, so "what is in it" has an answer

services.name: overview
services.doc: The shape of the whole map: repositories, sizes and totals.

services.name: toolSet
services.doc: Tool definitions shared by every answerer. `readSource(id)` is supplied by the page when code is available.

services.name: ZS
services.doc: zoom slider: log scale between the dataset's zoom limits, zooming around the centre of the view

services.name: DOCK
services.doc: map dock: one tooltip that slides to the hovered or focused button

services.name: provenance
services.doc: Where the summary text came from, shown under it so people (and agents) know how far to trust it.

services.name: ROLE_ICON
services.sig: const ROLE_ICON = { entry: '→', hub: '✳', bridge: '⇄', deadEnd: '■', isolated: '○' }

services.name: aboutHTML
services.doc: Summary, roles, signature and location.

services.name: impactHTML
services.doc: How far a change to service id reaches, with a toggle to light it up on the map.

services.name: identityLines
services.doc: Name, kind, place in the hierarchy, source location and summary.

services.name: serviceLines
services.doc: Roles, impact and connections of a service.

services.name: leafLines
services.doc: Callers and callees of an endpoint.

services.name: copyForAI
services.doc: The selected item as Markdown for an AI agent: identity, purpose, role, impact, connections, location, link.

services.name: svgOf
services.doc: Boxes and arrows as SVG; `start` gets a dot.

services.name: loopHTML
services.doc: A loop: the stops without repeating the start.

services.name: graphHTML
services.doc: A route or branching answer: edges follow the call direction (> calls the next stop, < is called by it).

services.name: stagesHTML
services.doc: A pipeline: stage titles on a rail, items as text buttons.

services.name: bars
services.doc: Bars of counts by module (domain), biggest first.

services.name: impactSummary
services.doc: "What breaks if I change X": counts, then everything affected grouped by module.

services.name: tangleSummary
services.doc: The module tangle: which modules hold it together, and its tightest two-module loops.

services.name: visualHTML
services.sig: export function visualHTML(flow, summary, at, i, width)
services.doc: The picture for a finished answer, or '' if it has none.

services.name: thread
services.doc: Conversation: { q, text, steps, status: 'thinking'|'streaming'|'done'|'error', mode: 'claude'|'llm'|'local', note }

services.name: mode
services.doc: AbortController of the running question

services.name: showing
services.doc: a model takes over once reachable

services.name: mention
services.doc: index of the answer whose items are on the map

services.name: off
services.doc: { start, items, act }

services.doc: Whether Ask Atlas is turned off on this page (search and shortcuts leave it out).

services.name: suggestions
services.doc: Suggestions for an empty conversation, chosen so each one has a real answer on the current map.

services.name: openAsk
services.doc: Open the panel, optionally asking a question right away.

services.name: closeAsk
services.doc: Close the panel (the conversation is kept until "New conversation").

services.name: inView
services.doc: Whether every item is already on screen (then the camera stays put).

services.name: followOnMap
services.doc: While an answer streams, light up what it has cited so far and the trail between them (no camera move).

services.name: showOnMap
services.doc: Light up an answer's items on the map (everything else dims) and bring them into view.

services.name: readMentions
services.doc: Replace @mentions by names and collect their refs.

services.name: wait
services.doc: Wait, unless motion is reduced; rejects as cancelled when Stop is pressed.

services.name: ring
services.doc: Ring an item on the map while the answer talks about it.

services.name: tokens
services.doc: Words, spaces and citations as separate tokens, so a citation never streams in half-written.

services.name: play
services.doc: Play a script: think, show each step (ringing its item), then stream the text in.

services.name: answerWithModel
services.sig: function answerWithModel(turn, q, refs, sel, ctl)
services.doc: Ask Claude with the map's tools, streaming into the turn.

services.name: onFailure
services.sig: function onFailure(turn, e, q, refs, sel)
services.doc: A stopped or failed answer: keep what can stay; fall back to the index when Claude isn't available.

services.name: setLLM
services.doc: The model is reachable (a transport) or not (null): switch modes and show the key box when it is not.

services.name: withCaret
services.doc: The blinking caret goes at the end of the text, inside the last paragraph or list item.

services.name: mermaidFor
services.doc: Mermaid text for an answer: from its step line, or from the trail between the items it cites.

services.name: resumeAnimations
services.doc: Entrance animations resume where they were: each element carries the time it first appeared.

services.name: metaHTML
services.doc: Under a finished answer: what answered it.

services.name: syncAskContext
services.doc: Keep the "About …" chip in step with the selection.

services.name: init
services.doc: Wire the panel. Called once from main.js.

services.name: resetAsk
services.doc: Clear the conversation when the dataset changes (refs belong to one graph).

services.name: leftWas
services.doc: a left panel and the open Key would overlap: fold the Key while a panel is open, restore it after

services.name: syncLegend
services.doc: Fold the Key while a left panel is open; restore it afterwards.

services.name: sources
services.doc: The source bundle for the current graph, if it has one.

services.name: locate
services.doc: Where an item's source is: file, first and last line.

services.name: hasSource
services.doc: Whether "View source" can show anything for this item.

services.name: JS_TOKENS
services.doc: a light JavaScript highlighter: comments, strings, numbers, keywords (enough for reading, not a parser)

services.name: linesOf
services.doc: HTML for every line of a file, highlighted once and cached.

services.name: openSource
services.doc: Open the source of item id beside the inspector.

services.name: closeSource
services.doc: Close the source view and return focus to what opened it.

services.name: sourceLines
services.doc: The plain lines of a definition, for Ask's read_source tool (in the product: fetched live from GitHub, not stored).

services.name: datasetOf
services.doc: A dataset button's value: a synthetic size is a number; Self and map keys stay strings.

services.name: mapButtons
services.doc: Builds with embedded maps offer those maps, and only those, in the dataset control.

services.name: syncThumb
services.doc: segmented controls: radiogroups with a sliding thumb and arrow-key navigation

services.name: tipTO
services.doc: first tooltip waits a beat; once one is open, neighbours appear instantly with no animation

services.name: fieldHTML
services.doc: Directions panel: built from small pieces, each returning HTML (all dynamic text goes through esc).

services.name: summaryHTML
services.doc: Hop count, what the route passes through, and which link types it crosses.

services.name: legendHTML
services.doc: What solid lines, dashed lines and moving dots mean.

services.name: noteHTML
services.doc: Explain backward steps: two things joined only through something they share is a weak connection.

services.name: renderRoute
services.doc: Render the Directions panel for the current route state.

services.name: rtHits
services.doc: directions fields: type-ahead over services and endpoints (an endpoint routes via its service)

services.name: closeDirections
services.doc: Close the Directions panel and clear the route.

services.name: copyText
services.doc: Copy text to the clipboard; the toast shows `label` (or the text itself, if short).

services.name: ICON_X

services.name: openLinkInspector
services.doc: Show the proof of HTTP link group gid in the inspector.

services.name: linksGroup
services.doc: The links between services, one row per proof in the line style the map draws, then their protocols.

services.name: sections
services.doc: The section switcher and the sections it shows, one visible at a time.

services.name: showSection
services.doc: Show section `v` without rebuilding the Key, so focus stays on the switcher.

services.name: autoOpenLinks
services.doc: Open the panel when a map with links loads, unless the viewer closed it or the tour holds it.

services.name: holdLinks
services.doc: While held, a map loading does not open the panel; holding closes it, without counting as the viewer's choice.

services.name: toggleLinksPanel
services.doc: Toggle the panel (the dock button and the L shortcut).

services.name: renderLinks
services.doc: Render the panel for the current map (hidden on maps without links).

services.name: proofBadge
services.doc: A badge for a proof, with what it means as its tooltip.

services.name: codeHTML
services.doc: The few lines of code around a cited line, the cited line marked.

services.name: siteHTML
services.doc: One end of a link: repository, file:line with its GitHub link, the function or handler, and the code.

services.name: checksHTML
services.doc: What SCIP said about each name the link rests on.

services.name: linkInspectorHTML
services.doc: The inspector for an HTTP link group: both ends, every call site, the proof, and the endpoint's impact.

services.name: groupRow
services.doc: A row for a link group: the far end, its repository and its proof.

services.name: impactBlockHTML
services.doc: What a change would break, with a toggle that lights it up on the map.

services.name: httpSectionHTML
services.doc: The HTTP sections of a node's inspector: the route an endpoint serves and its callers, a file's endpoints, the requests a function or file sends to other repositories, and impact. Empty for nodes no link touches.

services.name: accuracyHTML
services.doc: How the links scored on an answer key built without the tool; says so plainly when nothing was measured.

services.name: meaningHits
services.doc: Items whose summary contains every word of the query (3+ letters), excluding those already found by name.

services.name: snippet
services.doc: Summary snippet with the query words marked.

services.name: looksLikeQuestion
services.doc: Does the text read like a question rather than a name?

services.name: steps
services.doc: { root, shade, rings, card }, built the first time the tour opens

services.name: at
services.doc: the steps that apply to the map the tour started on

services.name: startedOn
services.doc: the step on screen; -1 while the tour is closed

services.name: switching
services.doc: the graph shown when the switch step began (it waits for another)

services.name: asked
services.doc: Next on the switch step asked for the other map

services.name: shown
services.doc: the sample question was sent

services.name: settleUntil
services.doc: the answer's diagram was scrolled into view

services.name: lastFocus
services.doc: follow the target every frame until then

services.name: drawn
services.doc: ResizeObserver on the step's target

services.name: movedAt
services.doc: what place() last drew, so a frame where nothing moved writes no styles

services.name: linksShown
services.doc: when the lit parts last moved

services.name: SMOOTH
services.doc: the tour opened the links panel (else closing it opens the panel, as a map load would)

services.name: repoCount
services.doc: Repositories on the map, without the stand-in for services outside them (where outside links end).

services.name: otherMap
services.doc: The map after the current one, for the switch step.

services.name: question
services.doc: The sample question: set for the demo maps; elsewhere a route between the busiest pair of repositories.

services.name: boxOf
services.doc: An element's box, or null when it is not on screen.

services.name: linkBox
services.doc: The link whose proof is open, on the map: its two ends and the arc between them.

services.name: screenBox
services.doc: Map points to a box on screen, padded for arcs that bulge past their ends.

services.name: TESTS
services.doc: a route or calling file under tests/ is real but a poor first example: production code reads better

services.name: firstLink
services.doc: The best-proven link in the panel between two repositories: an HTTP call in production code confirmed by SCIP, then by syntax, then any HTTP call (tests included), then any link. The panel may list outside services or an inferred Kafka topic first.

services.name: showLinks
services.doc: Open the links panel if the viewer closed it, and scroll its first link between repositories into view.

services.name: focusFirstLink
services.doc: For keyboards: focus that link, so Enter opens it.

leaves.name: wait
leaves.doc: the map may sit still while the answer streams in, so watch for the diagram here, not in tick()

services.name: fit
services.doc: Keep the lit box inside the window, with a margin around the target.

services.name: roundRect
services.sig: function roundRect({ x, y, w, h })
services.doc: A rounded rectangle as a path, for one hole in the dim.

services.name: beside
services.doc: The part of `b` beside `a`, on whichever side leaves more of it (a link running under the proof panel is lit up to the panel's edge, not merged with it); null when too little is left to see.

services.name: merge
services.doc: Lit boxes that overlap become one: with an even-odd fill, an overlap would be dimmed again.

services.name: drawHoles
services.doc: The dim over the whole window with a hole for each lit box, and a thin ring around each hole.

services.name: cardSpot
services.sig: function cardSpot(r, cw, ch, W, H, lit)
services.doc: Beside the lit box: right, left, below or above, whichever fits first without covering a lit part; else at the bottom. With nothing lit, in the middle.

services.name: place
services.doc: Light the current step's target and put the card beside it.

services.name: settle
services.doc: Every frame for a moment after a change, so the light follows panels as they slide in.

services.name: showDiagram
services.doc: Once the sample answer draws its diagram, scroll the Ask panel to it (on a phone it starts below the fold).

services.name: tick
services.doc: Follow the target; on the switch step, move on once the other map is showing.

services.name: enter
services.doc: Play the card's entrance (a short fade and rise in place).

services.name: onLinksClick
services.doc: The links step waits for a real link: the links panel opens its proof, then the tour moves on.

services.name: startTour
services.doc: Open the tour at its first step (the Tour button, or the first visit).

services.name: closeTour
services.doc: Close the tour (Skip, Escape or Finish); it is not shown again on its own.
